title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-27
source: Recording Info: Recorded by Kidd at the soundboard - MAR > R > CD; Transfer Info: Mastered via the Apogee Mini Me(24/96) > Mini Dac > Lynx One soundcard > Wavelab 5.0 > TLH Flac8; Transferred and Edited By Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: Stunning audience recording praised for its sublime, front‑stage feel, with a 24‑bit version offering even more detail.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers gush over the audio quality, calling it incredible and sublime despite being an audience source. The capture places the listener right in front of the stage and a higher‑resolution 24‑bit version is recommended, while no specific musical moments are mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: Two 5‑star reviews focus on the exceptional sound quality; lack of any commentary on the performance itself keeps the overall rating just below perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as sublime and front‑of‑stage, with a 24‑bit version noted for even greater fidelity; no major flaws reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on the musical performance or set flow were provided.
